_readme: Everything below uses plain names — exactly what you'd see typing into Halo or NinjaOne. No IDs to look up or manage; the agent finds the technical ID itself each run. To add a remediation action, copy one of the examples in remediation_whitelist and change the wording — nothing else needs to change.

on_call._comment: text_email (email-to-SMS gateway address) can be left blank — e.g. no SMS on-call set up yet. The agent always sends the email notification and simply skips the text when text_email is blank; that's expected, not an error.

halo._comment: These must match team/status/agent names exactly as they appear in Halo. 'agent_username' is the Halo user account the agent works as: it claims unassigned tickets under that name and picks back up tickets already assigned to it. Change this if you rename the account or swap to a different one — nothing else needs to change, the agent re-resolves the ID by name every run.

knowledge._comment: Where the agent documents newly-discovered fixes for long-term reuse. Must match the Hudu folder name exactly (create it once in Hudu if it doesn't exist yet).

claude._comment: Cost/quality controls passed to `claude -p`. Leave a field blank to use the account default (claude-opus-5, effort 'high'). Set to Sonnet/medium as the working default after the $4.13/62-turn Opus/high baseline run - compare a few -WhatIf runs' WOULD DO quality against that baseline before trusting escalation/frustration judgment calls at this cheaper setting. See README's 'Reducing per-run cost' section.

remediation_whitelist.name: Reset M365 password
remediation_whitelist.requires: Ticket contact's email matches the target account's login exactly.

remediation_whitelist.name: Unlock M365 account
remediation_whitelist.requires: Account confirmed to belong to the ticket contact.

remediation_whitelist.name: Reboot workstation
remediation_whitelist.requires: Device belongs to the ticket contact, is not a server, and the user has been told a reboot is happening.

remediation_whitelist.name: Run NinjaOne script: Reset Printing
remediation_whitelist.requires: Print-related issue only. Script name must match exactly what's in NinjaOne.

remediation_whitelist.name: Run NinjaOne script: Clear Print jobs and restart spooler
remediation_whitelist.requires: Print-related issue only. Script name must match exactly what's in NinjaOne.
